speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Breast Milk Jaundice). The clinical picture of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with significant hyperbilirubinemia (16.1 mg/dL) and increasing yellow discoloration is most consistent with breast milk jaundice, which typically presents after the first week of life. While stool color was not explicitly described in the latest input, the absence of cholestatic signs (like white stools) and the specific timeline support this diagnosis over biliary atresia.
